comments.body: Neat, so this is pretty rare then, huh?
I wonder how the rest of the thorax holds up. I'm sure mutations like this are how many beetle families diverged in part unthinkable quantities of years ago.

Weird! It's tiny!

@silversea_starsong, have you ever seen anything like this?
No, not at all. Physical issues on beetles don't tend to have a survival prospect through the pupa...
